cards.title: Still repeating the same admin task every day?
cards.problem: Copying information between emails, spreadsheets and separate tools takes time and can introduce avoidable mistakes.
cards.solution: Map the current steps first. Then test a simple form, shared tracker or low-code automation for one repeatable task. Keep a manual review step until the process is reliable.

cards.title: Visitors reach your website but do not enquire
cards.problem: A website can look polished yet leave visitors unsure what you offer, who it is for, or what they should do next.
cards.solution: Make the main service and target customer clear above the fold. Add one prominent contact action, explain the next step, and test the enquiry journey on mobile.

cards.title: Project updates are scattered across chats and emails
cards.problem: When requirements, decisions and progress live in multiple places, teams can miss changes or disagree about what is complete.
cards.solution: Create a single shared project tracker with owner, task, status, due date, blocker and evidence of completion. Agree on a regular update rhythm with the client and delivery team.

cards.title: Your team has a skills gap but no time to recruit blindly
cards.problem: A vague role description can attract mismatched applicants and slow down project delivery.
cards.solution: Write down the deliverables, must-have skills, expected availability and interview task before searching. Evaluate candidates against the same criteria and verify relevant work samples.

cards.title: Small businesses often postpone basic security checks
cards.problem: Shared passwords, outdated software and missing backups can turn a minor incident into a costly interruption.
cards.solution: Start with multi-factor authentication, unique passwords in a reputable password manager, automatic updates and a tested backup. Assign an owner and review access regularly.
